headline: VICTORIA IS QUEEN: Young Princess Awakened at Dawn to Learn She Reigns
dispatch: Kensington Palace, June 20. The Archbishop of Canterbury and the Lord Chamberlain arrived at the palace before five o'clock this morning to inform Princess Victoria that King William IV had died in the night and that she was now Queen. The eighteen-year-old received the news alone, composed herself, and at once held her first Privy Council. The new reign begins this day.
answer: Queen Victoria becomes Queen of Britain, 1837
